_meta.purpose: MISC Starlancer MAX ship + zone definitions.
_meta.axis_convention: Width = port-to-starboard (X). Length = ramp-end to forward (Y). Height = floor up (Z). All units are 1.25 m cubes; scu_capacity = width x length x height.
_meta.ramp_note: The Starlancer MAX loads via the rear; both bays use ramp_side='low_y' with ship_forward_y='high' so the rear/entry end renders at the bottom of the diagram.
_meta.adjacency_note: left_zone_label / right_zone_label list zones that are physically open to each other so a wide load can span them. No zones on the Starlancer MAX connect laterally — every column is walled/walkway-separated — so all adjacency fields are null.
_meta.layout_note: Forward bay = two columns F1/F2 (2 x 16 x 2 = 64 SCU each). Rear bay = side columns R1/R2 (2 x 8 x 3 = 48 SCU each) flanking the bulk floor. The bulk floor is split into RBA (Bulk Aft, the 4 x 8 x 2 = 64 SCU main slab running alongside R1/R2) and RBF (Bulk Fore, the 6 x 2 x 2 = 24 SCU wider cap past the forward end of R1/R2 where the bay opens up to span the full width). Both pack cleanly: RBA fits exactly 8 standard 8-SCU pads (2 wide x 4 along), RBF fits exactly 3 standard 8-SCU pads (3 wide x 1 along), totaling the 11 reliably-loaded pads matching the in-game rating.
_meta.bulk_drain_note: RBA + RBF are bulk overflow zones — they get the highest unload_priorities so the planner only fills them when smaller bays can't take more, and the post-load consolidation pass drains them BACK into lower-priority same-destination zones whenever room opens up (e.g. after a Baijini unload empties R1, any Seraphim cargo sitting in RBA migrates to R1/F1/F2 if there's a same-dest topoff target).
_meta.totals: Ship total = F1 64 + F2 64 + R1 48 + R2 48 + RBA 64 + RBF 24 = 312 SCU.

zones.notes: Forward bay, port column. 2 x 16 x 2 = 64 SCU.
Forward bay, starboard column. 2 x 16 x 2 = 64 SCU.
Rear bay, port column. 2 x 8 x 3 = 48 SCU.

Bulk Aft — the 4 x 8 x 2 = 64 SCU main slab of the bulk floor, running alongside R1/R2 (y=0..7). Fits exactly 8 standard 8-SCU pads (2 across x 4 along). Last-resort priority above the F/R columns. Cargo placed here is drained back into lower-priority same-dest zones whenever room opens up.

Bulk Fore — the 6 x 2 x 2 = 24 SCU wider cap past the forward end of R1/R2 (y=8..9, where the bay opens up to its full 6-cube width). Fits exactly 3 standard 8-SCU pads (3 across x 1 along). Lowest pick-order on the ship: only filled when everything else is full, and drained back first.
Rear bay, starboard column. 2 x 8 x 3 = 48 SCU.
